summary: Artemis Lunar Base Commander is an interactive mission trainer designed to prepare aspiring explorers for the realities of living and working on the Moon's South Pole. Players manage a 10-Sol lunar outpost across four critical survival systems: Power, Air/O₂, Water, and Regolith Radiation Shielding, alongside Crew Morale. Through realistic mission scenarios—such as clearing lunar regolith dust from solar arrays, managing thermal radiators, and maintaining ECLSS life support—players make strategic decisions while unlocking an interactive science glossary and earning 7 specialist mission badges. By combining gamified resource management with real NASA Artemis mission data, our trainer transforms complex spaceflight engineering into an accessible, hands-on educational experience for students and future astronauts.
details: Our team conceived the game concept, educational mechanics, lunar survival variables (Power, Air/O₂, Water, Shielding, Crew Morale), and interactive science glossary. We utilized Super Intelligence (SI) tools—specifically Google Gemini, Bolt, and Microsoft Copilot—as development accelerators via iterative prompting to generate the application code, vector illustrations (astronaut character and lunar habitat), and sound effects.
